title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing security between UE and network.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by network to initiate security mode control procedure.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to complete security mode control procedure.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to reject security mode control procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3460
entities.description: Timer used for retransmission of SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

entities.name: Lower layer failure before SECURITY MODE COMPLETE or REJECT
entities.description: Condition where lower layer fails before receiving SECURITY MODE COMPLETE or REJECT message.

entities.name: Expiry of timer T3460
entities.description: Condition when timer T3460 expires, triggering retransmission or procedure abortion.

entities.name: Collision with UE initiated procedures
entities.description: Condition where security mode control procedure collides with attach, service request, tracking area updating, or detach procedures.

entities.name: Collision with other EMM procedures
entities.description: Condition where security mode control procedure collides with other EMM procedures not listed in collision case c.

entities.name: Non-delivered NAS PDU due to handover
entities.description: Condition where SECURITY MODE COMMAND message cannot be delivered due to intra MME handover.

entities.name: Abort procedure
entities.description: Network behavior to abort the security mode control procedure.

entities.name: Retransmit message
entities.description: Network behavior to retransmit SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

entities.name: Progress both procedures
entities.description: Network behavior to continue both security mode control and other EMM procedures.

relations.description: Lower layer failure before SECURITY MODE COMPLETE/REJECT causes network to abort security mode control procedure.
First four T3460 expiries cause network to retransmit SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.
Fifth T3460 expiry causes network to abort security mode control procedure.
When retransmitting SECURITY MODE COMMAND, network resets and starts timer T3460.
Collision with UE initiated procedures causes network to abort security mode control and proceed with UE procedure.
Collision with other EMM procedures causes network to progress both procedures.
Non-delivery due to handover causes network to retransmit SECURITY MODE COMMAND after successful handover or if S1 connection exists.
Security mode control procedure includes sending SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.
Security mode control procedure expects SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message from UE.
Security mode control procedure may receive SECURITY MODE REJECT message from UE.
